name: XL4015
description: Cheap 36 V, 5 A, 180 kHz non-synchronous buck in TO-263-5, the chip on the popular 5 A adjustable buck/CC-CV modules.
notes: The metal tab is SW, not GND: don't pour ground under it.
8 V minimum input; needs a Schottky diode (the datasheet uses a 10 A / 45 V MBRD1045G) and a 47 µH-class inductor.

extras.note: Internal regulator bypass: 1 µF ('105') from VC to VIN, NOT to GND (pin table: 'connect a 1uf capacitor to VIN'; CC in all app circuits).
TO263-5L metal tab is SW (pin 3), not GND: give it SW copper for heat, keep it out of the ground pour.

notes: Non-synchronous P-MOSFET (60 mOhm typ) buck, fixed 180 kHz (144-216 kHz), internally compensated; drops to 48 kHz under output short. Max duty 100 %, min dropout 0.3 V.
Switch current limit 7 A typ (VFB = 0 V); no min/max given.
Feedback: VOUT = 1.25*(1 + R2/R1), R2 = top, R1 = bottom. Datasheet circuits: 5 V 10 k/3.3 k, 12 V 13 k/1.5 k, 20 V 15 k/1 k, each with CFF 33 nF across R2. VFB 1.225-1.275 V.
Output: 330 µF/25 V electrolytic plus a 1 µF ('105') ceramic C2 in parallel in the 5 V and 12 V circuits; 470 µF/35 V + 1 µF in the 20 V/5 A circuit. No capacitance range is specified.
Input: 220 µF/50 V electrolytic CIN plus a 1 µF ('105') ceramic C1 VIN-GND (470 µF/50 V in the 20 V/5 A circuit). cinUf = the electrolytic bulk, cinHfNf = the 1 µF ceramic.
Inductor: 47 µH rated 5 A in all standard circuits; 47 µH rated 12 A in the 'high power' 20 V/5 A circuit. The datasheet gives no inductor equation or ripple target.
Schottky catch diode SW-GND is mandatory; GND pin should sit outside the diode-to-output-cap ground path to keep switching spikes out of the IC ground.
VIN 8-36 V operating, abs max 40 V; FB abs max 7 V. Iq 2.1 mA typ. Typical efficiency 87 % (12->5 V, 5 A), 93 % (24->12 V, 4 A).
No enable, power-good or soft-start pins.
The TO-263 tab is SW (pin 3), not GND: give it SW copper and keep it out of the ground pour.
